decisions.summary: Implement the approved development foundation plan with everyday scoped development first, linked canonical specifications, one Python producer, selective intent review, and assessment-only modernization. Preserve existing root constraints and leave older draft intent unresolved.

Owner requested the three Compass intent-preservation improvements with dogfooding and iteration. Pronto consumes helper-owned bootstrap and bounded task context, preserving original foundation constraints and unrelated draft subsystems.

Owner accepted the source-backed Pronto subsystem organization in BOUNDARY_REVIEW.md: inventory/routing, quality/remediation, provider/release context, Telescope, analytics, skill evidence, interaction quality, desktop delivery, preserving the accepted Compass foundation. Acceptance is limited to organization and documented preservation obligations; unreviewed path assignments, proof, feature activation, installation and modernization remain outside this decision.

Source association review of the already-accepted local persistence, domain compatibility and explicit action boundaries. Mixed dispatch/model/transport paths are root-owned shared integration, with named subsystem consumers; this does not infer a new product purpose or authorize commands.

Source association of existing designated behavior under accepted root outcomes. This neither creates a new subsystem purpose nor authorizes publication, owner decisions, promotion or external mutations.

A sibling edit must still reassess the Compass consumer.

constraints: Do not mutate the inspected repository from a map.
Authored draft meaning must stay distinct from measured source topology.
Cancellation must not store a partial successful projection.
Preserve workspace-bound cache invalidation and explicit partial/unknown coverage.
AI enrichment stays disabled by default; a guarded handoff is not execution authority.
bindings.handoff_review: Reviewed against owner-ratified Telescope boundary, docs/telescope.md, core/telescope.rs and native/renderer oracles. Behavior Assurance owns canonical action definitions; inventory owns selected workspace identity; readiness tasks synchronize into Pronto remediation without execution. These source associations preserve existing intended behavior rather than ratifying observed implementation as intent.

constraints: Only successful structured provider events establish invocation counts; discovery, instruction text, source parity and installation do not.
Unavailable telemetry must not be presented as observed zero, and history before feed coverage is unknown.
Do not store prompts, responses, skill contents or attributable thread/turn identifiers in the snapshot.
Collector activation and exporter replacement require separate lifecycle authority.

Shared core/API/type consumers are explicit dependencies; installation and runtime acceptance remain separate evidence obligations.

constraints: Capture stays fail-open and privacy bounded, with sanitized excerpts and explicit retention.
Individual observations, local recurrence, cross-scope recurrence and intervention hypotheses remain separate.
Proposal acceptance records human judgment and never starts implementation.
Spool failures retain actionable sanitized diagnostics; one incompatible record must not block independent records.

constraints: Metrics on a shared axis must agree on unit, denominator, aggregation, time semantics and window.
Missing historical maturity evidence stays unavailable; CI scores cannot backfill it.
Accepted quality evidence creates observations; rejected evidence creates none; unchanged fingerprints deduplicate.
Local saved views preserve curated protection; observations do not establish causal claims.

constraints: Source, packaged build, installed artifact and running process are separate evidence identities.
Missing or stale manifests and a reused PID cannot establish current runtime parity.
Repository manifests are read-only bounded data and never executable instructions.
Bootstrap proof does not install, restart or activate a runtime.
Keep stable manifest-backed accessibility identifiers, roles and labels aligned with rendered controls; manifest/test agreement alone is not live assistive-technology proof.
Folder-picker cancellation is a no-op and registration/refresh failures remain visible; do not cross into scans or provider changes after a failed prerequisite.

constraints: Use current selected-workspace Git and explicit repository role policy; cached inventory or remote labels cannot replace local identity.
Doctor failure withholds dependent next-action and fold recommendations; inspection remains read-only and bounded without clipping safety evidence.
Preserve dirty, active, malformed, unsupported and uncertain custody evidence. The custody projection grants no adoption, integration, deletion or push authority.

The isolated-change workflow owns signed custody and transfers; Pronto projects lifecycle and granular dispositions separately. Legacy task_lanes and newer custody surfaces have different adoption predicates; neither is mutation authority.
Workspace-policy generation is plan-first and exact-scope; writes require explicit --write, existing differences require --replace, and symlink or unresolved conflicts block application.
bindings.handoff_review: Source and negative-oracle associations reviewed against owner-accepted subsystem organization and the linked specifications. Inventory owns selected workspace identity; producer-owned quality and external provider evidence remain independent inputs. Renderer and CLI present these inputs without conferring mutation authority. Direct installed-runtime and full inventory coverage remain separate proof obligations.

constraints: Quality Runner owns evidence meaning and freshness; Pronto preserves producer provenance, target identity, failures and unknowns in its consumer projections.
Observation recency and evidence-contract currency remain separate. Legacy readable reports cannot satisfy a current evidence obligation.
Tier-0 behavior release readiness is distinct from all-tier edge coverage, maturity and routine warnings; missing, stale or mismatched required evidence cannot become passed.
Remediation execution permission and plan closure are separate gates; unresolved closure does not automatically prohibit safe scoped execution.
Use existing remediation IDs and handoff checks. Preserve original workspace identity, ownership and checkpoint checks; assessment and proposals do not execute source repairs.

The pre-CR coverage placeholder explicitly declares no instrumentation; it is not measured test coverage. Foundation readiness remains advisory and does not block urgent fixes or authorize modernization.

constraints: Provider acquisition is read-only context; remote refresh does not authorize GitHub writes, publication or local Git mutation.
Provider errors retain their actual cause; authentication failure is not inferred from every unavailable network request.
Release preparation remains advisory, with no rule producing review-only; explicit blockers and no-change dispositions are retained.
Current release-boundary evidence must match branch, commit, policy digest, required checks and packaged artifact identity. Legacy receipts remain audit-required.
AI assistance is off by default and handoff-only; manual portfolio grouping and local repository identity remain canonical.

constraints: Preserve versioned local storage migrations and existing CLI/renderer snapshot shapes; serialized refresh must not overwrite independent repository evidence.
Shared transport routes do not grant permission. Read-only inspection, explicit local configuration, provider acquisition and authorized handoffs retain their individual predicates.
A desktop bridge that is absent cannot silently simulate a successful mutating command; missing/stale evidence stays explicit.
Keep selected repository/workspace/branch identities through quality, provider and remediation handoffs; preserve unavailable, blocked and partial dimensions.
Mixed source files are shared integration obligations, not independent proof of every subsystem. Follow the affected consumers and their own current proof.
bindings.handoff_review: Root owns shared persistence, domain models and command composition. Child bindings list these shared paths as dependencies, so changes reassess consumers without assigning several owners to one file. Core tests verify serialization, migration, selected-workspace and doctor/release predicates; bridge tests verify invocation and fallback. They do not prove installed UI or new provider behavior.

constraints: Public eligibility is explicit and precedes public ranking; private/client work never enters the public queue or receives a public priority score.
Unknown, blocked and not-applicable dimensions remain categorical. Registration/refresh does not create contract rows or infer publication authority.
Preserve product readiness, materials readiness, career signal and work priority as distinct dimensions; a concept is not current behavior or published proof.
Public material claims require their own evidence, privacy, attribution, accessibility and owner review; structural material tests do not prove all narratives or external readback.
bindings.handoff_review: Existing Showcase contract and material-workspace README explicitly assign this production surface, its per-project routes, previews, claim ledgers and retained evidence. Exact tracked file associations route future changes to these preservation obligations; they do not ratify individual narrative claims or establish current external proof. Native tests cover private exclusion, unknown state and nonmutating unreviewed discovery. Structural material checks do not prove every package narrative, historical receipt or live public behavior. Refreshing a claim requires its own owning repository evidence and editorial/owner review. Two generated Quality Runner full-page PNG captures are explicitly excluded from source coverage because they exceed the helper reference limit; their package manifest remains mapped. Their visual content and freshness require separate rendered evidence and cannot satisfy current runtime proof.

constraints: AWL owns discovery, tests, quantification and candidate formation; Pronto reads the fixed local inbox and records an explicit owner choice.
Only complete undecided candidates admit owner decisions; incomplete drafts and decision history remain separate read-only projections.
Public/private/both require a ready sanitized JAS projection; JAS owns validation, preflight and application, with a sanitized result returned to AWL.
Unavailable providers and failed receipt persistence remain visible. Reading the inbox does not authorize a decision or invocation of apply.
bindings.handoff_review: Existing promotion-inbox specification refines the root governed-handoff outcome; source associations do not ratify a new child. Native tests cover incomplete/already-decided refusal and projection parsing; renderer mocks cover unavailable/provider admission display. Actual AWL/JAS application, private artifact containment and persisted cross-provider receipts require separate integration proof and explicit owner action.
